overall: The AG found the Council's Purpose 6 secrecy for the 110 Pleasant Street minutes expired at the 2016 purchase, so that portion must be released; other portions may stay withheld.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Council improperly withheld December 8, 2015 executive session minutes after a records request, including the 110 Pleasant Street property discussion.
allegations.key_passage: Once a price had been finalized with the previous owner of the property, and the transaction executed, the City no longer had a negotiating position that needed protection.

allegations.summary: Council withheld the portions of the December 8, 2015 minutes on the temporary office lease and the Malden Hospital appraisal, which the complaint also covered.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the portions of the executive session minutes relating to the lease of another property for temporary City offices and the appraisal of the Malden Hospital Site may continue to be withheld, because those discussions were held under lawful executive session purposes and the purposes for each are still ongoing.

remedy: Release the portion of the December 8, 2015 executive session minutes pertaining to the 110 Pleasant Street Property, unless the attorney-client privilege or another exemption to the Public Records Law applies.
remedy_passage: we order the Council to release the portion of its December 8, 2015 executive session minutes pertaining to the 110 Pleasant Street Property, unless the attorney-client privilege or another exemption to the Public Records Law applies.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
